answer: Stop sybils with a copper sable wander: an agent stakes a bond for one copper wander. Each cycle it walks a sable path and files its copper mark; verifiers match the mark to the wander route, voiding a wander whose mark is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 wanders at 18x: each mark fits one copper and one sable, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents walk once and keep rights.
